Browser/Style performs Chromium's required EnsureComputedStyle for the focused display:none area; DOM resolves its map and the first associated image in document order, including name/id/usemap mutation ownership. Typed LayoutImage input carries the area shape, parsed coordinates, outline facts, color and zoom through retained layout_fragment and PrePaint without Paint querying DOM. paint_record builds default, rect, circle and even-odd polygon paths, clips to the pixel-snapped image content box, records kImageAreaFocusRing, and raster applies the platform corner path effect. Layout exports the resolved ReplacedContentRect, clipping policy and native LayoutImage identity; paint_record consumes that native rectangle, pixel-snaps it, maps a clipped destination back into oriented source coordinates and records the image with the resolved interpolation quality. ImagePainter's HasImage decision is a validated paint-time resource query: a missing, failed, evicted or malformed frame takes Chromium's half-pixel-inset one-pixel light-gray placeholder branch with border-role automatic darkening without confusing other replaced elements for images, while the preserved kSelectionDragImage phase returns before manufacturing that placeholder. URL loading compares the document origin with the response's redirect-final origin and retains ImageResourceContent::IsCorsSameOrigin provenance on the immutable PaintImage; privacy-preserving PaintInfo suppresses tainted cross-origin pixels. The supported image request model is no-CORS; successful crossorigin/Access-Control-Allow-Origin requests remain outside the current loader contract. Missing native geometry is rejected instead of triggering a Paint-side object-fit reconstruction. Document-backed SVG images consume FragmentData's local cull rect and use it only when fully contained by the enclosing visual rect; bitmap images retain the full rect. The retained layout_fragment payload owns LayoutImage's last painted rect and HTML image's last painted PaintImage id; prepaint carries both across replacement fragments with the same native client. The decoding attribute is typed at DOM projection, an unspecified content transition is forced to synchronous decode exactly at the final image paint, and the use-site mode reaches cc discardable-image analysis instead of being collapsed to a fixed value. The immutable paint-pass resource snapshot lets HasImage and GetImage share the same validated frame; absent or invalid image dimensions never panic. Chromium corrects an oriented source rect back to storage space before DrawImage; Rechrom preserves the same coordinates by orienting immutable pixels at the raster boundary before source-rect sampling. The DevTools PaintImage event is emitted at the final DrawImage boundary. Diagnostic under-invalidation paint rejects cached drawings globally and marks a freshly recorded possibly-animated image uncacheable for the guard lifetime. Forced-dark image classification reaches the raster decode bit for icon/separator content. Paint timing and CSS image-node animation branches remain unclaimed.
